sentences.text:
This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of B.N.S.S., 2023/439 of Cr.P.C.,
1973 for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.137/2025 registered at Police Station - Piparia,
District Narmadapuram (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 34 of IPC.

Applicant is in detention since 09.04.2025.
2.

As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is that he, by cheating the company, in connivance with fake customers Kailash and Rameshwar, prepared fake Adhar card documents, knew that the address written in the documents was fake, and dishonestly verified the customers' identity documents and address etc. to be correct and by using those documents as original, got loan facility provided to both the customers from the company and caused financial loss to the company by destroying the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:30426 2 MCRC-23490-2025 tractors the said two customers.
On the basis of which, FIR was registered against them.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 09.04.2025.
He is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is further submitted that applicant was appointed temporarily on 27.11.2023.
He was on probation.
He was not the authority to sanction loan.
When the fact came into the knowledge of the company that two persons were not paying the loan, even then he was in service of the company for nine months.
FIR was lodged after nine months.
Charge sheet has been filed.
There is no criminal record of the applicant.
The trial of the case will take considerable time.

Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be Naresh Belawanshi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30259923/
1 released on bail pending the trial.

sentences.text: 4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State as well as learned counsel for the objector have opposed the bail application.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:30426 3 MCRC-23490-2025 480(3) of BNSS.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
